About me

Hi, I'm Lori!

I live in the Yarra Ranges and I really love bees. One day I started making lip balms with beeswax and now it's my very own little business! My mum helps me with the hot bits, but I do heaps of it myself.

I make every balm in our kitchen in small batches with simple, natural stuff. I even have a real ABN like a proper business. When you buy a balm you're helping me follow my dream, and that makes me really happy. Thank you so much!

From hive to lips

How I make my balms

Have a scroll and watch how I do it! 🐝

1

Happy bees

It all starts with bees! They give us the beeswax that makes my balms so good for your lips.

2

Real beeswax

I use organic beeswax and other natural things. No yucky stuff goes in, I promise!

3

I mix it all up

I melt everything and mix in the options, then pour it into little tins. My mum helps with the hot bits.

4

All done!

I pop the lids on, stick the labels, and check each one. Then it's ready for your lips! 💛

Good to know

Questions and answers

The things people ask me most.

What is in the balms? Are there allergens?

My balms are made with organic beeswax and simple natural ingredients. They are not medicines. The full ingredient list is on every label, so if you have any allergies please check the label or ask me first before you use one.

How do I order?

Pop the balms you want into your basket and go to checkout. Choose how you would like to pay, fill in your details, and place the order. It opens an email to me with everything, or you can message me on Messenger. I will confirm with you before any payment.

How can I pay?

You can pay by PayID or bank transfer, by card or PayPal, or with cash if you pick up locally. You choose at checkout, and I will send you the details to finish paying.

Do you post, or can I pick up?

You can pick up locally in the Yarra Ranges for free, or I can post your order within Australia. We will sort out postage and timing when I confirm your order. Because I make everything fresh in small batches, please allow a little time.

What if something is not right?

Your rights under the Australian Consumer Law always apply. If a balm is faulty or not as described, email me with your order number and a photo and I will sort out a refund or replacement. For hygiene reasons I cannot take back a balm that has been opened just for a change of mind.

Who makes them?

I do! I am a young maker in the Yarra Ranges and I make every balm by hand, with my mum helping on the hot bits. When you buy one you are cheering on my little business. Thank you! 🐝
